author: Hailer Oy
description: Customer dashboard — assets, support tickets, contacts, opportunities, ManikinPC, rentals, online orders, and trips/IHS visits, all in one place for any client.
versionDescription: Added a manual '↻ Refresh' button next to the customer picker — re-fetches data in the header and all 8 tabs without resetting which customer is selected (the two are independent state, unlike reloading the page). No automatic background refresh, by design — just the button.
